changes.before: Active (extended) as of 2026-09-23; the second 180-day moratorium, passed as an emergency on 2026-06-15, took effect 2026-07-05 and runs to about 2027-01-01. Bristolville 25 Developer/BHGH Properties' mandamus case remains pending in the Ohio Supreme Court (developer's June 18 motion to compel site-plan review undecided per WKBN). The moratorium committee's consultant presented proposed data center zoning standards to council; no vote yet. Council separately adopted a 180-day moratorium on small modular reactors and battery energy storage systems in July 2026.
changes.after: The Ohio Supreme Court opinion decided October 20, 2026 denies the requested Bristolville/BHGH writ concerning site-plan review under premoratorium law and identifies the June 15 extension as Ordinance 29-2026. This disposition does not establish resolution of every legal issue or subsequent proceeding. The signed extension section 7 states a maximum 180 days from effectiveness, while its recital refers to passage. Actual effective anchor, operative endpoint and later action remain unresolved.
